Every `codify` command, read from the parser the command line builds. Commands are grouped in the order the guide uses them. Flag defaults that come from the environment are shown as the code's own fallback; see [Environment variables](environment.md).

## Acquire sources

Guide: [Acquire sources](../guide/acquire-sources.md).

### `index-datadump`

map CELEX to archive member for a bulk FORMEX archive.

```bash
codify index-datadump [-h] [--out OUT] [--language LANGUAGE] [--max-files MAX_FILES] [--quiet] archive
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `archive` | string | required | path to the bulk FORMEX zip |
| `--out OUT` | string |  | index JSON to write (default: &lt;ACQUISITION_INDEX_DIR&gt;/eu/index.json) |
| `--language LANGUAGE` | string |  | ISO 639 code of the archive; read from its filename when omitted |
| `--max-files MAX_FILES` | integer |  | stop after N members |
| `--quiet` | flag |  | suppress progress |

### `index-ee-archive`

index the statutes in force in a Riigi Teataja bulk XML zip.

```bash
codify index-ee-archive [-h] [--out OUT] [--principal-only] [--max-files MAX_FILES] [--as-of AS_OF] [--keep-ended] [--quiet] archive
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `archive` | string | required | path to the Riigi Teataja XML zip (e.g. xml.2026.zip) |
| `--out OUT` | string |  | index JSON to write (default: &lt;ACQUISITION_INDEX_DIR&gt;/ee/index.json) |
| `--principal-only` | flag |  | only index principal acts and codes |
| `--max-files MAX_FILES` | integer |  | stop after N members |
| `--as-of AS_OF` | string |  | keep redactions in force on this ISO date (default: today) |
| `--keep-ended` | flag |  | also list redactions ended before the as-of date, under their own section |
| `--quiet` | flag |  | suppress progress |

### `index-legislation-gov-uk`

enumerate every item the publisher's feeds list, per type and year.

```bash
codify index-legislation-gov-uk [-h] --jurisdiction JURISDICTION [--out OUT] [--types TYPES] [--year-from YEAR_FROM] [--year-to YEAR_TO] [--quiet] [--resume]
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--jurisdiction JURISDICTION` | string | required | jurisdiction code carrying the adapter |
| `--out OUT` | string |  | index JSON to write (default: &lt;ACQUISITION_INDEX_DIR&gt;/&lt;jurisdiction&gt;/index.json) |
| `--types TYPES` | string |  | comma-separated type tokens; all when omitted |
| `--year-from YEAR_FROM` | integer |  | first year to list |
| `--year-to YEAR_TO` | integer |  | last year to list |
| `--quiet` | flag |  | suppress per-year progress |
| `--resume` | flag |  | continue the build at --out (same types and years); otherwise --out is overwritten |

### `index-ocs`

enumerate every law and subordinate law the Thai Council of State's search lists.

```bash
codify index-ocs [-h] [--out OUT] [--rate RATE] [--quiet] [--resume]
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--out OUT` | string |  | index JSON to write (default: &lt;ACQUISITION_INDEX_DIR&gt;/th/index.json) |
| `--rate RATE` | integer | `30` | requests per minute, one at a time |
| `--quiet` | flag |  | suppress per-page progress |
| `--resume` | flag |  | continue the build at --out if its total still holds |

### `crawl-ocs`

save the raw document of every timeline an OCS index lists.

```bash
codify crawl-ocs [-h] --out OUT [--index INDEX] [--kinds KINDS] [--rate RATE] [--quiet]
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--out OUT` | string | required | directory for raw documents; the configured acquirer reads &lt;ACQUISITION_INDEX_DIR&gt;/th/raw |
| `--index INDEX` | string |  | index JSON (default: &lt;ACQUISITION_INDEX_DIR&gt;/th/index.json) |
| `--kinds KINDS` | string | `"current"` | timeline kinds to follow beyond those listed: original,amending,consolidated,current |
| `--rate RATE` | integer | `30` | requests per minute, one at a time |
| `--quiet` | flag |  | suppress progress |

## Structure and check one document

Guide: [Structure and check one document](../guide/structure.md).

### `ingest-one`

run one document through the pipeline into a bundle.

```bash
codify ingest-one [-h] --jurisdiction JURISDICTION --out OUT [--model MODEL] [--ocr-model OCR_MODEL] [--fallback-model FALLBACK_MODEL] [--quiet] source
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | string | required | path to the source PDF, or a .txt of already-extracted text |
| `--jurisdiction JURISDICTION` | string | required | jurisdiction code, e.g. xa |
| `--out OUT` | string | required | bundle directory to write |
| `--model MODEL` | string | `"gemini-3.7-flash"` | body-fill model (default: gemini-3.7-flash); the manifest records which model ran |
| `--ocr-model OCR_MODEL` | string |  | transcription engine; empty is the vision route on the body-fill model |
| `--fallback-model FALLBACK_MODEL` | string |  | model retried on any content-filter refusal (pages, metadata, body-fill); empty disables |
| `--quiet` | flag |  | suppress per-event progress |

### `segment`

re-run the segmenter over a bundle's stored text into segmentation.json.

```bash
codify segment [-h] [--jurisdiction JURISDICTION] bundle
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bundle` | string | required | bundle directory written by ingest-one |
| `--jurisdiction JURISDICTION` | string |  | config to segment under (default: the bundle's) |

### `scan-corpus`

measure the anchor scan over a directory of raw sources.

```bash
codify scan-corpus [-h] --jurisdiction JURISDICTION [--per-document PER_DOCUMENT] [--check BASELINE] [--containment] [--include-derived] root
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `root` | string | required | directory searched recursively for .txt and .pdf sources |
| `--jurisdiction JURISDICTION` | string | required | jurisdiction code, e.g. xa |
| `--per-document PER_DOCUMENT` | string |  | write one JSON row per document to this path |
| `--check BASELINE` | string |  | compare against a pinned baseline; exit 1 naming every drifted key |
| `--containment` | flag |  | report which passes this sweep read the motivating document for; exit 1 when one was missed, so a zero firing count is not mistaken for evidence the pass is dead |
| `--include-derived` | flag |  | also score our own exports (`<stem>.ar/.en/.he`), excluded by default |

## Store and search

Guide: [Store and search](../guide/search.md).

### `migrate`

bring the database at POSTGRES_URL to the current core schema (needs the migrations extra).

```bash
codify migrate [-h]
```

No arguments.

### `load`

write an ingest-one bundle (or an AKN file) into Postgres.

```bash
codify load [-h] [--jurisdiction JURISDICTION] [--title TITLE] [--doctype DOCTYPE] [--year YEAR] [--number NUMBER] [--embed] path
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | required | bundle directory or .akn.xml file |
| `--jurisdiction JURISDICTION` | string |  | defaults to the bundle's manifest |
| `--title TITLE` | string |  | defaults to the title the model read, in the bundle's manifest |
| `--doctype DOCTYPE` | string |  |  |
| `--year YEAR` | integer |  |  |
| `--number NUMBER` | string |  |  |
| `--embed` | flag |  | also embed its provisions for search |

### `search`

hybrid search over stored provisions, one JSON match per line.

```bash
codify search [-h] --jurisdiction JURISDICTION [--language LANGUAGE] [-k K] query
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | string | required |  |
| `--jurisdiction JURISDICTION` | string | required |  |
| `--language LANGUAGE` | string |  |  |
| `-k K` | positive integer | `10` | matches to return |

## Compare two versions

### `compare`

compare two versions, by stored id or AKN path, as a JSON report.

```bash
codify compare [-h] [--model MODEL] [--out OUT] left right
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `left` | string | required | the reference (directive) side |
| `right` | string | required | the domestic side |
| `--model MODEL` | string |  | chat model for the assessment |
| `--out OUT` | string |  | write the report here instead of stdout |

## Serve and publish

Guide: [Serve and publish](../guide/serve-and-publish.md).

### `serve`

run the HTTP server over the library (needs the serve extra).

```bash
codify serve [-h] [--host HOST] [--port PORT] [--openapi]
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--host HOST` | string | `"127.0.0.1"` |  |
| `--port PORT` | integer | `8000` |  |
| `--openapi` | flag |  | print the OpenAPI schema and exit |

### `mcp`

run the read tools as an MCP server over stdio (needs the mcp extra).

```bash
codify mcp [-h] [--http] [--host HOST] [--port PORT]
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--http` | flag |  | streamable HTTP at /mcp instead |
| `--host HOST` | string | `"127.0.0.1"` |  |
| `--port PORT` | integer | `8001` |  |
